subject: Supplier portal onboarding — PO prefixing & MSA/order-form coordination
messages:
From: Elena Ramos <procurement@acme-med.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ariba Onboarding <onboard@ariba.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood vendor enrollment — PO prefix and MSA question

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for taking this forward — Acme is ready to proceed with Redwood but we have two gating items from our procurement/finance side before activation in Ariba: a) we require that inbound POs include a buyer prefix (we use "ACME-") that must be parsed into our ERP so we can auto-match invoices, and b) we need confirmation on a narrow MSA clause: our legal team asked that Section 3.2 of the Order Form explicitly state that invoices are accepted when the PO prefix matches our format and the invoice references the Order Form ID.

I've attached our PO requirements doc (acme_po_requirements.pdf) and can share a sample PO XML if it helps. Can Redwood map the prefix into a dedicated field in Ariba/Coupa so our downstream systems can rely on it?

Elena Ramos
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Medical Systems
procurement@acme-med.com

Attachment: acme_po_requirements.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ramos <procurement@acme-med.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor enrollment — PO prefix and MSA question

Elena — thanks for the note and the attachment. Looping in Legal (Marissa) and Onboarding/Integrations (Karthik + Laura) so we can give a single response and a proposal for the Ariba mapping.

Quick summary of our plan:
- Karthik to confirm whether our Ariba connector can capture the buyer PO prefix (ACME-) into a discrete field (we typically map BuyerPO and Reference fields).
- Legal to review the suggested language for Section 3.2 and propose minimal redline that preserves our billing and SLA commitments.
- If both are ok, we will deliver an updated Order Form + DocuSign link and configure a validation rule on the onboarding side so POs with the ACME- prefix are accepted and routed to your ERP mapping.

I've attached a draft mapping sheet (po_field_mapping.xlsx) with columns for Ariba XML tags, Redwood mapping, and validation rules. Karthik — can you confirm by EOD which tag you want to see as the canonical prefix?

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: po_field_mapping.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <procurement@acme-med.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor enrollment — PO prefix and MSA question

Elena/Team — I reviewed Acme's attachment and drafted a concise redline to the Order Form Section 3.2 that accomplishes Acme's objective without expanding our liability. Key points:

- Proposed language: "Seller will accept invoices tied to Purchase Orders that include the buyer-specific prefix (e.g., 'ACME-') where the prefix is mapped to the Order Form ID within the procurement portal. Such invoices shall be considered valid for payment processing provided the Order Form ID is present and the invoice otherwise complies with the payment terms."
- We are not agreeing to additional acceptance conditions outside of the prefix/Order Form ID pairing.
- I attached a short redline summary (redline_summary.pdf) and highlighted one legal ask: please confirm whether Acme requires any additional attestations on goods/services received — if so, surface the specific text.

If Acme confirms the single-prefix approach, I can finalize the redline and we can push the updated Order Form via DocuSign.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redline_summary.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Elena Ramos <procurement@acme-med.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor enrollment — PO prefix and MSA question

Elena/Sofia — quick technical note from integrations: we can map the prefix. In our Ariba connector we typically parse the BuyerPO element and populate the internal field "buyer_prefix" during onboarding. Two implementation notes:

1) If Acme's ERP requires the prefix in a separate field, we will add a transformation rule: when BuyerPO starts with "ACME-" we strip the prefix and store it in buyer_prefix for routing; the rest of the PO number remains.
2) We can add a simple validation rule at onboarding (reject POs that do not match the ACME- regex) or tag them for manual review.

I've attached a sample XML snippet showing the BuyerPO tag mapping (po_mapping_snippet.xml). Laura — once legal signs off, let's schedule a quick 30-min handoff with Ariba onboarding (onboard@ariba.com) to update the endpoint and test with Acme test POs.

Karthik Iyer
Lead Integrations Engineer — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: po_mapping_snippet.xml

From: Elena Ramos <procurement@acme-med.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Ariba Onboarding <onboard@ariba.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood vendor enrollment — PO prefix and MSA question

Thanks everyone — this looks great and aligns with our finance requirements. Acme confirms: the buyer prefix approach is acceptable provided the prefix is captured and the Order Form ID is present on invoices. We don't need any extra attestations beyond that.

I've initiated the Order Form via DocuSign (link below). We'll sign the updated Order Form after Legal finalizes the short redline Marissa proposed.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/envelope/SIGNED-ENVELOPE-12345
